Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Chicago passenger sues American Airlines for exposing her to AIDS when an employee bit her after an altercation 2. Evangelical Women's Caucus International approves resolution endorsing civil rights protection for homosexuals 3. ACLU declares the New Orleans ordinance banning cross-dressing and lewd behavior unconstitutional COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 4. Man accused of murdering wife after she called him gay 5. Andy Humm on radio host Bob Grant spreading hatred against gays 6. Ferrysburg, Michigan wants to change town name due to teasing over connotation of "fairies" COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 7. Newman's Own company includes American Foundation for AIDS Research in its list of charities 8. AZT approved for use in the United States, for certain cases of AIDS 9. Psych study finds gays as anxious about growing old as straight men, eroding the "old queen" stereotype 10. Reading viewer donation letters COMMERCIAL: Gay Cable Network fundraiser 11. Sports Report, interview with Joe Franco about "Gayrobics" COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation with Jose Sarria 12. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Coverage of "With the Greatest of Ease" gay band convention COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine 2. Mystic Fire video, clips of Paul Bowles interview 3. Clips from AZT news conference, coverage from CNN 4. TV show Superior Court deals with AIDS controversy COMMERCIAL: Gay Cable Network fundraiser 5. Interview with proponent of alternative AIDS therapy using Vitamin C injections 6. Closing credits
